tools.name: list_monitored_vendors
tools.description: Guest-safe index of vendors with public incident feeds (id, name, category, website). Pass id to get_vendor_incidents. Sign in with Huntertech MCP OAuth or an API key to expand tools/list with history (includeResolved, timePeriod), get_incident, maintenance, and analytics.

tools.name: get_vendor_incidents
tools.description: Read-only incidents for one monitored vendor. Guest and Free: ongoing plus monitoring only, max 5 (default when status is omitted). tools.name: get_all_vendor_incidents
tools.description: Read-only cross-vendor incident snapshot (newest start first). Guest and Free: ongoing plus monitoring only, max 5. Optional status filters ongoing, monitoring, or resolved; resolved requires Standard or higher (includeResolved, timePeriod, or status=resolved). Signed-in callers get additional tools

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
